tokoh_utama: An Indonesian man in his mid-20s with short messy black hair, wearing a gray t-shirt and dark casual trousers, anxious facial expression

part.pertanyaan: Kalau dapat paket misterius begini, kamu buka atau buang?
part.caption: Misteri paket tanpa pengirim yang terus berdatangan tiap malam... Isinya bikin merinding!

adegan.narasi: Jangan pernah buka paket misterius yang datang tanpa ada nama pengirimnya.
adegan.gambar: A cardboard package lying on a dark wooden porch doorstep at night, illuminated by a flickering porch light, close-up shot.

adegan.narasi: Tiap jam 12 malam, kotak kardus selalu tergeletak di teras rumahku.
adegan.gambar: The main character standing at his open front door at midnight, looking down nervously at a small cardboard box on the doormat.

adegan.narasi: Paket pertama berisi jam tangan SMP-ku yang hilang belasan tahun lalu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of hands opening a cardboard box, revealing an old broken silver wristwatch inside, its hands stopped at midnight.

adegan.narasi: Malam berikutnya, datang lagi paket berisi gantungan kunci kayu milik almarhum Kakek.
adegan.gambar: Hands holding a dusty carved wooden keychain taken from a second cardboard box on a wooden desk inside the house.

adegan.narasi: Aku mulai takut karena barang-barang kenangan ini harusnya sudah tidak ada.
adegan.gambar: The main character holding the old keychain, looking terrified with sweat on his forehead in a dimly lit room.

adegan.narasi: Aku langsung memeriksa rekaman CCTV rumah lewat aplikasi di HP-ku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a glowing smartphone screen held by hands, displaying a security camera feed interface.

adegan.narasi: Anehnya, rekaman itu menunjukkan teras kosong tanpa ada kurir yang datang.
adegan.gambar: CCTV camera view of an empty dark house porch at night, quiet and deserted with street lights in background.

adegan.narasi: Lampu teras berkedip pelan saat aku memperhatikan layar HP dengan teliti.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the smartphone screen showing CCTV feed. In the dark distance down the empty street, a faint small shadow of a young child stands watching.

adegan.narasi: Jam tiga malam, suara ketukan pelan kembali terdengar dari pintu depan.
adegan.gambar: The main character standing frozen in his dark hallway, looking towards the wooden front door in panic.

adegan.narasi: Aku memberanikan diri membuka pintu dan mengambil kotak kardus kecil itu.
adegan.gambar: The main character reaching down cautiously to pick up a small brown box from the porch floor in the cold night air.

adegan.narasi: Tangan dingin menahan napas saat jemariku merobek plester pembungkus paketnya.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of trembling hands tearing open adhesive tape on a small cardboard package.

adegan.narasi: Isinya kunci kuningan berkarat, kunci rumah lamaku yang terbakar sepuluh tahun lalu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of an old rusty brass key with a burnt wooden tag resting inside the opened package box.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, siapa yang mengirim paket itu?
part.caption: Paket kali ini tidak dikirim dari luar... Tapi dari DALAM RUMAH!

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan paket misterius. Kunci rumah terbakar itu bikin aku tidak bisa tidur.
adegan.gambar: The main character sitting on his bed in a dimly lit bedroom at night, staring blankly with dark circles under his eyes.

adegan.narasi: Malam ini aku memutuskan begadang dan mengintip lewat lubang kecil pintu.
adegan.gambar: The main character pressing his eye closely against the door peephole in a dark entrance hall.

adegan.narasi: Suasana luar sangat hening, hanya ada suara angin dan motor jauh.
adegan.gambar: Peephole circular wide-angle perspective showing the empty dark porch outside the house at night.

adegan.narasi: Aku menempelkan mataku di lubang pintu dari jam satu sampai jam tiga.
adegan.gambar: Side view of the main character standing motionless at the front door, looking through the peephole intently.

adegan.narasi: Sama sekali tidak ada orang atau bayangan yang mendekati teras rumah.
adegan.gambar: Peephole perspective showing the deserted porch again under eerie moonlit darkness.

adegan.narasi: Merasa aman, aku berbalik badan untuk mengambil segelas air di dapur.
adegan.gambar: The main character turning away from the front door into the dark living room hallway.

adegan.narasi: Langkahku terhenti seketika saat melihat meja ruang tamu di belakangku.
adegan.gambar: The main character standing frozen in the dark living room. In the reflection of a dark turned-off TV screen on the wall, a creepy silhouette of a child is faintly visible standing behind the couch.

adegan.narasi: Sebuah paket kardus baru sudah tergeletak manis di atas meja kayu.
adegan.gambar: A fresh sealed cardboard package sitting neatly on top of the coffee table in the center of the dark living room.

adegan.narasi: Pengirimnya tidak lewat pintu depan, paket ini datang dari dalam rumah.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the main character looking down at the box on the table with wide terrified eyes.

adegan.narasi: Dengan gemetar, aku mendekati meja dan memotong solasi paket tersebut.
adegan.gambar: Hands nervously cutting open the tape of the cardboard box with a small utility knife.

adegan.narasi: Di dalam kotak, ada sebuah foto Polaroid dengan warna agak kusam.
adegan.gambar: Close-up inside the open cardboard box showing a single vintage Polaroid photograph lying face up.

adegan.narasi: Foto itu memperlihatkan diriku yang sedang tertidur lelap tadi malam.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the Polaroid photo showing the main character sleeping peacefully in his bed, taken from high above his head.

part.pertanyaan: Kira-kira siapa anak kecil itu dan apa yang bakal terjadi selanjutnya?
part.caption: Pesan terakhir di dalam paket bikin merinding disebujuk tubuh... Siapa sebenarnya dia?!

adegan.narasi: Foto tidur itu membuat hatiku hancur dan seketika otakku berpikir keras.
adegan.gambar: The main character dropping the Polaroid photo onto the table, clutching his head in panic.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba aku menyadari satu kenyataan mengerikan tentang semua barang misterius ini.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the main character's face illuminated by faint moonlight, realization and horror in his eyes.

adegan.narasi: Jam tangan, gantungan kunci, dan kunci rumah hilang pada malam yang sama.
adegan.gambar: The three lost items—the watch, wooden keychain, and rusty key—arranged side-by-side on the table.

adegan.narasi: Yaitu malam sepuluh tahun lalu, ketika rumah lamaku habis dilalap kobaran api.
adegan.gambar: A vivid memory flashback showing a wooden house engulfed in fierce orange flames and dark smoke at night.

adegan.narasi: Lampu ruang tamu mendadak berkedip cepat lalu mati total menyisakan kegelapan.
adegan.gambar: The living room hanging bulb flickering violently before turning completely pitch black.

adegan.narasi: Di atas meja, sebuah paket kardus terakhir sudah tergeletak begitu saja.
adegan.gambar: A final open cardboard package on the living room table under dim eerie moonlight.

adegan.narasi: Aku mendekat dan mengambil selembar kertas lusuh dari dalam kotak kardus.
adegan.gambar: The main character reaching out with trembling fingers to take an old yellowed paper from the package.

adegan.narasi: Tulisan di kertas itu sangat kukenal, itu tulisan tangan khas diriku saat kecil.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of handwritten messy child handwriting in dark ink on old burnt-edged paper.

adegan.narasi: Surat itu tertulis,
adegan.gambar: The main character holding the letter up to read it, his shadow stretching long across the floor.

adegan.narasi: Surat itu berbunyi, "Aku masih di rumah lama. Kenapa kamu pergi tanpa aku?"
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the handwritten sentence on the paper: 'Aku masih di rumah lama. Kenapa kamu pergi tanpa aku?'

adegan.narasi: Napas dingin mendadak berembus tepat di belakangan leherku yang meremang.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the back of the main character's neck, goosebumps rising on his skin in the dark room.

adegan.narasi: Bayangan anak kecil hitam berjelaga perlahan muncul dari sudut ruangan gelap.
adegan.gambar: A dark corner of the living room where a shadowy silhouette of a small soot-covered child stands silently, eyes dimly glowing.

adegan.narasi: Dan sekarang, pintu rumahku terkunci rapat, tak bisa dibuka lagi.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of the main character backing away towards the front door, grabbing the lock handles frantically in pitch darkness.
